preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 65000), and the second line is a string s of length n containing only digits 1-9.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '123456789' for c in stdin.split()[1])
preconditions.description: All characters in the string s are digits from 1 to 9.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(1 for l in range(n) for r in range(l, n) if int(s[l:r+1]) % 2 == 0))
postconditions.description: The output is the count of all substrings s[l..r] (1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ n) where the number represented by the substring is even.
